# Stroma

> Stroma is a Community Medicine app for MBBS students and MD residents. Colleges still teach the subject from K. Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine. Stroma is notes, a resident course, and calculators. It does not distribute that textbook.

Stroma is published by Bottlegram Health (Anshuman Sinha). The public site is https://bottlegramhealth.in/. The app is on the App Store (https://tinyurl.com/appstroma) and Google Play (https://tinyurl.com/playstroma).

## Notes

- [Concept of health and disease](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/concept-of-health-and-disease/): definitions, triad, iceberg, levels of prevention
- [Pearl index](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/pearl-index/): formula and a worked example
- [Screening calculations](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/screening-sensitivity-specificity/): sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV
- [Park, Marrow, review books, and Stroma](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/community-medicine-apps-mbbs-md/): MBBS and MD comparison
- [How to study Community Medicine](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/how-to-study-community-medicine/): revision order before a prof
- [PSM notes for MBBS](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/psm-topics-for-mbbs-exams/): the topic map
- [K Park notes](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/park-textbook-alternative/): what the textbook is for, and what the notes are for
- [Biomedical waste](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/biomedical-waste-management/): the four colour bags
- [Disaster management](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/disaster-management/): the cycle and triage colours
- [Health education](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/health-education/): communication, IEC, and behaviour change
- [Health planning](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/health-planning/): the planning cycle, monitoring, and evaluation
